text:
Olga Petrova: quick follow-up from the canary this morning — we hit a streaming stall when a safetensors blob was served inside gzip. stream-loader assumed raw safetensors and blocked waiting for frames.
Mike Chen: ugh. did the HTTP layer return content-length?
Olga Petrova: yes, `content-length: 0` for the range probe in one codepath (bug in proxy), so loader treated it as streamable but decoder failed.
Sara Patel: that aligns with the customer report (partial response -> OOM on worker).
Lee Wong: proposal: add a tiny HEAD-based "format-probe" handshake before starting streaming hotloads. HEAD returns a header `x-rw-format-probe: <format-id>` so loader can pick index-first vs stream-first.
Mike Chen: nice. format-id could be a short enum: `sf` (safetensors), `sf+gz`, `tgz`, `tar`, `bin`. keep it small.
Sara Patel: can we avoid an extra roundtrip for high-QPS hotstarts? overhead matters.
Olga Petrova: yes — the probe should be cheap and cached by our edge layer for a TTL (e.g., 60s). also we can do a fast-range probe (first 512 bytes) in the same GET for E2E if we do not get a HEAD.
Lee Wong: so fallback tiers: 1) HEAD probe + cached header, 2) small-range GET (first N bytes) inline, 3) start streaming with a short decode timeout and immediate abort to switch to index-first.
Mike Chen: need runbook for failure modes — if probe header missing or conflicting, prefer index-first to avoid stalls. streaming can be an opt-in for verified endpoints.
Sara Patel: telemetry: tag requests with `probe=head|range|none` and `decision=stream|index`. we need SLOs for probe latency too.
Olga Petrova: agree. Also add heuristics: if file size < 1MB and `content-encoding: gzip` absent, allow direct streaming. else prefer index-first.
Lee Wong: implementation tasks: (1) edge support for `x-rw-format-probe` TTL cache, (2) loader changes for tiered probe, (3) add probe telemetry, (4) update hotstart-runbook.
Mike Chen: assign me and @Lee to loader changes, Olga you take edge cache TTL work?
Olga Petrova: taking edge work. Sara can you own telemetry and runbook?
Sara Patel: yep, will add a checklist in runbook: how to force index-first, how to flip streamer flag per-model, and drill steps for OOM cascade.
infra-bot: created ISSUE-ML-1245: "format-probe HEAD header + tiered fallback" assigned to Mike Chen, Lee Wong, Olga Petrova, Sara Patel. ETA tentative: 2 sprints.
Mike Chen: small compatibility note: third-party registries won't set `x-rw-format-probe`. loader must handle unknown gracefully.
Lee Wong: we'll implement a small local probe cache in the loader to reduce HEADs across concurrent hotstarts on same host.
Olga Petrova: test plan: unit tests for header parsing, integration test against gzipped safetensors, chaos test where HEAD returns 200 but range returns truncated payload.
Sara Patel: add a canary with traffic split 1% on Dedicated for two weeks before full rollout.
Mike Chen: sounds good. I'll open PR with interface sketch for loader side and include proto of header values.
Olga Petrova: thanks — let's sync async on the PR thread. :thumbsup:
